issues_found: Minor phrasing: summary states 'inflation has returned to the 2% target' while source says 'has been around 2%' and 'remains close to 2%' — 'returned to' is slightly more assertive than the source language

Document age: published 2025-01-29, approximately 15 months before TODAY (2026-04-14); this is outside the 90-day window but the document has clear archival value as it establishes the Bank of Canada's analytical framework and policy stance at that time

corrected_fields.summary: The Bank of Canada reduced its overnight rate by 25 basis points to 3% and announced an end to quantitative tightening, reflecting confidence that inflation has remained around the 2% target. The Bank forecasts Canadian economic growth to average 1.8% in 2025 and 2026, with excess supply expected to gradually dissipate. A major source of uncertainty is the threat of new US tariffs, which is already weighing on consumer and business confidence and contributing to Canadian dollar depreciation.
